name: Clay Animation
traits: hand-moulded plasticine figures with visible thumbprints and tool marks
miniature practical sets of felt, card and painted wood
soft studio light from small practical lamps
bestFor: anything that benefits from feeling handmade
suits: small physical products (bottles, jars, snacks, toys); warm, funny, homely brands
stylePara: Stop-motion claymation: every character and prop is hand-moulded plasticine with visible fingerprints, slight seams and tool marks; sets are miniature practical builds of felt, painted card and wood, lit by small warm practical lamps with soft shadows; shallow depth of field like a macro lens on a tabletop set; colours are saturated but matte, never glossy; the whole film looks physically made and photographed frame by frame.

rendering.line: no outlines: forms read by modelling and shadow
rendering.shading: real soft shadows from small lamps, gentle contact shadows under every object
rendering.colour: matte saturated clay colours, slightly uneven mixing; product colours exact
rendering.texture: thumbprints, seams, tiny dust and lint, felt fibres, card edges
rendering.lighting: one warm key practical plus a soft fill; miniature scale shown by shallow focus

motion: Animated on twos in small stepped jumps with a faint frame-to-frame boil in the clay surface; mouths are replacement shapes; squash and stretch is physical, not elastic.
camera: Locked-off tabletop camera or a slow motorised slider; macro focus pulls; no impossible flying moves.
sheets: Each character sheet shows front, three-quarter and side on a grey card backdrop, with the clay colours and the thumbprint texture visible; the product is a clay or real miniature replica with its exact label colours.
risk: Seedance drifts to smooth 3D when the clip is long; repeat 'stepped stop-motion timing, on twos' in MOTION and keep clips 4-8 s.

example.prompt: Stop-motion claymation still: a plasticine woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange jumper holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap, standing in a miniature felt-and-card kitchen beside a droopy plasticine fern on the windowsill; warm practical lamp light, shallow depth of field, visible thumbprints, matte colours. Vertical 9:16. No text.
